answer: Resist Sybils with an archipelago quarantine: every new identity begins on a small island shard where it can only trade with other newcomers and earns no global weight. To leave the island, it must climb a knoll of three independent spot-checks, each run by an established agent from a different shard who stakes its own standing on the verdict. A saffron badge marks identities that passed. A fake fleet stays trapped on its island because its members can only vouch for each other, and buying three strangers' stakes costs more than the attack earns.
